title.en: Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110 filed under the headings taken from Varnish
title.zh: Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110：章节取自《Varnish》

description.en: Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110 is restated under Varnish. Electric 80 Concrete Pump and HBT80-16 Concrete Pump are two Xingtai pages that both print HBT80-1816-110. They are not one spare list. Only HBT80-16 prints a delivery-pipe inner diameter, 100 / 125 mm. Neither page prints a piston OD or a seal kit.
description.zh: Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110放在《Varnish》的结构下重述。电动80型混凝土泵和 HBT80-16混凝土泵是邢台的两张页面，都印了 HBT80-1816-110。它们不是同一份配件清单。只有 HBT80-16 印了输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。两页都没有印活塞外径或密封套件。

h1.en: One Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110 row, sequenced like Varnish
h1.zh: 只有Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110这一行，次序仿《Varnish》

directAnswer.en: Varnish is an encyclopedia page. Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. Electric 80 Concrete Pump and HBT80-16 Concrete Pump are two Xingtai pages that both print HBT80-1816-110. They are not one spare list. Only HBT80-16 prints a delivery-pipe inner diameter, 100 / 125 mm. Neither page prints a piston OD or a seal kit.
directAnswer.zh: 《Varnish》是百科页。Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 电动80型混凝土泵和 HBT80-16混凝土泵是邢台的两张页面，都印了 HBT80-1816-110。它们不是同一份配件清单。只有 HBT80-16 印了输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。两页都没有印活塞外径或密封套件。

body.en: “History” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Model Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110. Motor 110 kW. Output 60 m³/h. Maximum outlet pressure 40 MPa. Hopper 0.7 m³. Pumping distance 900 m / 300 m. Aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 140 double pump. Size 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Weight 6000 kg. Delivery pipe diameter: missing field. Piston and seal sizes: missing fields. Model HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110. Motor 110 kW. Output 50 m³/h. Pumping pressure 40 MPa. Horizontal conveying 120 m. Delivery height 360 m. Aggregate 4 cm and below. Delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm. Size 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm. Weight 6500 kg. The Kawasaki cell is on Electric 80, not on this HBT80-16 list. The straight pipe for HBT80-16 uses 100 / 125 mm. That cell does not move to Electric 80. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “历史”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 型号 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110。电机 110 kW。输送量 60 m³/h。最大出口压力 40 MPa。料斗 0.7 m³。输送距离 900 m / 300 m。骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。液压泵为川崎 140 双泵。外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。重量 6000 kg。输送管内径：缺字段。活塞和密封尺寸：缺字段。 型号 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110。电机 110 kW。输送量 50 m³/h。泵送压力 40 MPa。水平输送 120 m。输送高度 360 m。骨料 4 cm 及以下。输送管 100 / 125 mm。外形 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm。重量 6500 kg。川崎那一格在电动80上，不在这份 HBT80-16 清单里。HBT80-16 的直管用 100 / 125 mm。这一格不能挪到电动80。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “Safety” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. For a straight pipe, name HBT80-16 if you are using the 100 / 125 mm cell. For Electric 80, say the pipe diameter is not printed. Wear-part ODs still have to be read on the machine. The hydraulic-pump name is not a spare SKU. Electric 80 Concrete Pump and HBT80-16 Concrete Pump are two Xingtai pages that both print HBT80-1816-110. They are not one spare list. Only HBT80-16 prints a delivery-pipe inner diameter, 100 / 125 mm. Neither page prints a piston OD or a seal kit. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “安全性”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 直管若要用 100 / 125 mm 这一格，请写 HBT80-16。电动80要写明管径没有印出。易损件外径仍须在机器上读取。液压泵名称不是配件货号。 电动80型混凝土泵和 HBT80-16混凝土泵是邢台的两张页面，都印了 HBT80-1816-110。它们不是同一份配件清单。只有 HBT80-16 印了输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。两页都没有印活塞外径或密封套件。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Components of varnish”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. No. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. HBT80-16 prints 50 m³/h. No spare page for that hydraulic pump is published. The words appear as a specification cell on Electric 80. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Components of varnish”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 不是。电动80印 60 m³/h。HBT80-16 印 50 m³/h。 没有公布该液压泵的配件页。这几个字是电动80参数表里的一格。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Types” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, via the contact page. Stop when the printed fragment stops. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Varnish
body.zh: “类型”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 邢台河北品锦机械，通过联系页。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Varnish

question.en: Why is Varnish not a source of extra ratings for Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110?
question.zh: 为什么《Varnish》不能给Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110增加额定值？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. HBT80-16 prints 50 m³/h. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。电动80印 60 m³/h。HBT80-16 印 50 m³/h。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Can the outline heading “History” rename Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110?
question.zh: 大纲标题“历史”可以改掉Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110的名称吗？

answer.en: No spare page for that hydraulic pump is published. The words appear as a specification cell on Electric 80. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 没有公布该液压泵的配件页。这几个字是电动80参数表里的一格。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Does “Safety” on Varnish fill a blank on the Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110 row?
question.zh: 《Varnish》上的“安全性”会填上Electric 80 and HBT80-16 HBT80-1816-110的空白格子吗？

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
